info.title: Polymorfa WhatsApp API
info.description: Public Polymorfa REST API for sessions, messaging, media, webhooks, campaigns, templates, client tokens, widgets, and bridge routing.

from.description: Meta wa_id. This is not a LID-backed user ID.

type.description: Ack type: error, delivered, read, played

statusReason.description: Reason for the status: SCAN_QR, AUTO_RECONNECT, FAILED, MANUAL_STOP, QR_TIMEOUT, LOGGED_OUT, TEMPORARY_BAN, STREAM_ERROR

banCode.description: WhatsApp temporary-ban code (present only when statusReason is TEMPORARY_BAN).

banReason.description: Human-readable label for the ban code (present only when statusReason is TEMPORARY_BAN).

banExpiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the temporary ban lifts, when WhatsApp provides a duration.

detail.description: Extra context for FAILED and STREAM_ERROR statuses (for example the connect-failure reason).

daysSinceLastSeen.description: Whole days since the phone was last seen online.

daysRemaining.description: Days remaining before WhatsApp disconnects the session (clamped to 0). WhatsApp typically severs the companion link after ~14 days of phone inactivity.

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time the phone was seen online.

action.description: Human-readable action string to surface to the end user (e.g. ask them to open WhatsApp on their phone).
action.example: Open WhatsApp on your phone to keep the session alive

labelId.description: Label ID affected by the action

allOf.description: Chat the label action applies to

label.description: Legacy field: the label's display name for label_edit, and the label ID for association actions. Prefer labelId and name.

orderIndex.description: Label ordering index when supplied by app state

deleted.description: Whether the label definition was deleted

labeled.description: Whether the chat or message association is active

observedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the app-state mutation was observed

starred.description: Whether the message is starred (present for star actions)

phoneNumber.description: The customer's own number in E.164 format.

kind.description: Enforcement outcome, or customer_report for a customer-reported ban.

source.description: Whether Polymorfa observed the enforcement or the customer reported it.

code.description: WhatsApp status code (for example 402, 403, 406, 475) when observed.

subCode.description: WhatsApp sub-code (101-106 for temporary bans) when provided.

reason.description: Sanitised reason from the WhatsApp code table.

enforcementType.description: WhatsApp enforcement type (for example BIZ_QUALITY) when provided.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the enforcement started.

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the enforcement lifts, when WhatsApp provides a duration.

title.example: Messages sent without showing that you are typing

phoneNumber.description: The customer's own number in E.164 format.

action.description: Whether the restriction was newly applied, moved, or removed. `daily_allowance_reached` reports that the number spent its warm-up allowance for the day; nothing on the ladder moved and sending resumes at the next reset.

scope.description: Whether this covers one number or every number in the workspace.

previousRung.description: Restriction previously in force, or null when none was.

health.description: Measured health from 0 (worst) to 100 (best), or null when not measured.

requires.description: Findings that must resolve before this restriction lifts.

throughputPerMinute.description: Messages per minute allowed while paced, or null when not paced.

eligibleLiftAt.description: Earliest instant the restriction can step down, ISO 8601.

liftRequires.description: One sentence describing what lifts the restriction.
liftRequires.example: Resolve the two open checks and keep them clean for six evaluations.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this restriction took effect.

sessionId.description: Session whose present Health crossed the project threshold.

projectId.description: Project whose Health rule produced this action.

threshold.description: Configured project threshold crossed by this evaluation.

healthSource.description: Estimator family used by the evaluation.

estimatorVersion.description: Estimator version used by the evaluation.

modelVersion.description: Learned-model version, or null for a rules-based estimate.

actionId.description: Stable event identity used for retries.

id.description: Incident id. Stable, quotable, and the subject of a Ban Insurance claim.

phoneNumber.description: The customer's own number in E.164 format.

kind.description: What WhatsApp did, or customer_report when you reported it.

source.description: Whether Polymorfa observed it or you reported it.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the restriction started.

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the restriction ends, or null when it has no end. A ban you report ends 24 hours after the time you give unless you report it again or Polymorfa observes the restriction itself.

belief.description: How confident Polymorfa is that this restriction was real, from 0 to 1. A restriction WhatsApp announced is 1. A ban you report starts at 0.9 and moves once the number's own sending shows whether it was restricted.

resolution.description: How the incident settled. open: still being decided. corroborated: a report and an observed restriction agree. contradicted: the number kept sending, so there was no restriction. phone_switch: the number moved to another phone. final: settled with the confidence shown.

claimId.description: The Ban Insurance claim this incident belongs to, or null when there is none.

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when you closed or retracted the report, or null.

incidentId.description: The incident this claim was filed against.

phoneNumber.description: The customer's own number in E.164 format.

status.description: Where the claim sits. filed and under_review are open. approved means it was accepted, and with a zero amount that there was nothing to return. paid means the credits are on your balance. reversed means what Polymorfa knew about the ban changed afterwards and the credits were taken back.

verdict.description: What the ban was attributed to. other_device: another device on the account was sending. customer_conduct: Polymorfa was already restricting this number, or named the same serious problem for a week. shared_network: the number shared its connection with numbers that were being restricted. ours: nothing points at how the number was used. inconclusive: Polymorfa could not see enough of the window to say.

windowStart.description: ISO 8601 start of the 30 days the refund covers.

windowEnd.description: ISO 8601 end of the window: the moment the ban started.

measuredCents.description: Credits this number consumed inside the window, in cents.

capCents.description: The most a claim on this number's plan can return, in cents.

amountCents.description: What this claim returns, in cents.

summary.description: One sentence describing the claim's state.

reason.description: One sentence describing what the ban was attributed to.

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the decision, or null while none was taken.

paidAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the credits landed, or null.

allOf.description: Recipient chat the send was attempted to

type.description: Type of the attempted message (text, image, ...)

code.description: Stable machine-readable code from the API error envelope, present for classified safety refusals and an unknown send outcome

retryAfter.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying a paced send, exhausted allowance, or temporary allowance-accounting pause

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the failure occurred

templateName.description: Template name as registered with Meta

status.description: New approval status: APPROVED, REJECTED, PAUSED, DISABLED, DELETED

reason.description: Reason for the status change; empty unless REJECTED, PAUSED or DISABLED

qualityRating.description: Quality rating bucket reported by Meta (GREEN, YELLOW, RED)

pausedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the campaign paused

completedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the last recipient settled

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration from launch to completion, in milliseconds

failedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the campaign failed

externalMessageId.description: WhatsApp message id of the delivered send

variantKey.description: Content variant used for this recipient

error.description: Sanitized failure class or stable code

failedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the recipient was marked failed

skippedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the recipient was skipped

at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of the pacing decision

capType.description: Which cap was reached: hourly or daily

windowResetsAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the cap window resets

at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of the decision
Unix timestamp in seconds when the recipient was held

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, present on safety and entitlement refusals

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the request can be retried, present on paced refusals and retryable service pauses

docs.description: URL to the documentation for this error

sessionId.description: Canonical per-org session identifier. Use this in /api/sessions/{session}/* paths.

connection.description: How the session connects to WhatsApp. 'linked_device' pairs as a WhatsApp linked device; 'cloud_api' uses the Meta Cloud API. Immutable after create.

testMode.description: Whether this session was created as a simulated testing number.

status.description: Current status: CONNECTING, CONNECTED, or DISCONNECTED

CloudApiCredentials.description: Meta credentials. Required when connection='cloud_api'. Encrypted at rest before storage.

projectId.description: Project id the session belongs to. Required.

sessionId.description: Canonical per-org session identifier (1-64 alphanumeric chars, dots, hyphens, underscores). Caller-supplied or generated; returned in the response. This is the id used in all /api/sessions/{session}/* paths.

name.description: Optional human-friendly label for the session. Not an id.

connection.description: How the session connects to WhatsApp. 'linked_device' (default) pairs as a WhatsApp linked device; 'cloud_api' uses the Meta Cloud API and requires the `cloudApi` creds block. Immutable after create.

testMode.description: Create a simulated testing number (behaves like a real session via the simulated universe). Defaults to false.

bartenderMode.description: Bartender privacy tier. Defaults to 'magic'. Mutable via the handoff ceremony at POST /api/sessions/{name}/handoff-keys + /handoff-import. 'magic' — Polymorfa holds the Signal session; full message visibility. 'passthrough' — Polymorfa holds noise creds only; neither messages nor app state are decryptable on Polymorfa's side. 'passthrough_plus' — Track P + customer has uploaded AppStateSyncKeys for selected collections (contacts, labels, mute/archive, blocklist), so Polymorfa sees metadata mutations but never message content.

runnerPublicKeyB64.description: Curve25519 public key the customer must seal their snapshot to. Base64 (URL-safe, no padding).

sealedEnvelopeB64.description: Sealed-box envelope (ephemeral_pub(32) || ciphertext) wrapping the customer's SignalStoreSnapshot. Base64.

snapshotHashHex.description: SHA-256 of the unsealed snapshot JSON, hex-encoded. The runner verifies after decrypt before flipping bartenderMode.

timestamp.description: Unix-seconds timestamp WA stamped on the key.

upgradeTo.description: When set, atomically flips sessions.config.bartenderMode → passthrough_plus after the keys persist. Eliminates the window where mode is set but no keys are staged.

snapshotHashHex.description: SHA-256 of the snapshot the customer received via mode.handoff_export. API verifies this matches what the runner exported before flipping bartenderMode.

qr.description: QR code data to encode into a scannable image

code.description: Numeric pairing code for device linking

status.description: Delivery status: pending, sent, delivered, read

template.description: Template send (cloud_api only). When set, type is ignored. Rejected on whatsmeow sessions.

participant.description: Sender JID of the message being marked read. Required by WhatsApp for group chats; when omitted the sender is resolved from the message id.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the profile picture
HTTPS image source fetched through Polymorfa's SSRF-safe downloader

mediaUrl.description: Already-uploaded WhatsApp or Meta media URL reused without downloading

format.description: "native" (default) = Polymorfa event envelope. "meta" = Meta Cloud API webhook shape (object/entry/changes/value), signed with X-Hub-Signature-256.

items.description: Exact HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query, fragment, or comma. A trailing root slash is removed.

BearerAuth.description: Polymorfa API key (pmfa_ prefix) or client token (pmfa_ct_ prefix).

post.description:
**Protocols:** Linked Device API · Meta Cloud API · Polymorfa Hybrid Link

**Required scope:** `messages:write`

Testing sessions accept a recipient testing number in E.164 format or as a phone-number JID, and can send only to active testing numbers in the same project. Malformed, unknown, stopped, deleted, and cross-project testing recipients all return 404 without creating recipient state.
